_note: Documentation only. Harvey 2014 published population parameters, used untuned as the Harvey2014_fixed route in methods/harvey/results/reference_tp_lockout/. Not a separate run. Values as in HARVEY_2014 and [methods.harvey] in methods/harvey/src/run_harvey.py and configs/harvey.toml.
source: Harvey RA, Dassau E, Zisser H, Seborg DE, Doyle FJ III. Design of the glucose rate increase detector: a meal detection module for the health monitoring system. J Diabetes Sci Technol 2014;8(2):307-320. doi:10.1177/1932296814523881

location.params: Harvey 2014, p. 312, Results and Discussion > Training and Validation, first paragraph: 'the best set of tuning parameters for the GRID' (tuned on the 12-subject closed-loop training set, Dexcom SEVEN PLUS, 5-min sampling; p. 310 describes the tuning but omits the values)
location.spike_max_roc_mg_dl_per_min: Harvey 2014, p. 308, Eq. 1: 'maximum allowable ROC, set to 3 mg/dL in a 1-minute period' (deviations.md H1)
